title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode8 Sharing Feelings

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: White Day
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, it looks like we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This is Rui's and my way of thanking all of you for everything that you do day to day. Enjoy, and bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow...! These cookies all have pictures on them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We used icing on them.
Each one has a unique design and message on it. Take any that suit your fancy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right... Today's White Day, huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow☆ This one has a Ferris wheel on it! And this one has a merry-go-round!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool☆ I can't decide which to choose.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Tsukasa, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I also have something that I wanna give all of you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Give us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
I wrote message cards to show just how much I appreciate all of you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Starting with you, Tsukasa! Here's yours!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh...!
I'd heard that you went to help out with an event involving making cards, but I wasn't expecting to receive one...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Hm...? All these star stickers...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see!
They must represent the shining star that I am!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ding ding ding!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm always encouraged by the way you do your absolute best every day! This is my way of thanking you for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I could say the same for you, Emu.
Let us both keep moving forward down the path to stardom!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next is... Rui! Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Hehe. Mine has robots and a jack-in-the-box on it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because you're always making robots and coming up with fun effects that surprise the audience☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for everything, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you as well. I'm constantly inspired by your sheer athletic talent and free imagination.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Next! Drum roll please...
Here's your card, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wow, these stickers are really cute...
Musical notes, and a princess singing a song?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Because you're always making lots and lots of people smile with your beautiful singing voice!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And thank you for always hanging out with me! Let's go grab some taiyaki again in the future!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'd love to...
Let's hang out again soon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next are my cards for everyone in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you made cards for us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's so nice of you!
Let's form a line, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I'd like to begin our fun and exciting message card exchange party!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We heard that we were going to be making our own message cards and exchanging them with each other...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But how are we actually supposed to make our cards?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Don't worry. We'll teach you guys everything that you need to know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! Starting with you, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I made your card in the shape of a guitar!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that...
It even has cactus stickers on it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I really admire how you're so passionate about what you do, Ichi.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “When you decide to do something, you just move straight toward it. You don't know how many times you've helped me by doing that.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I'm really glad that you're my friend, so thank you! I hope we get to be besties forever and ever!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki...
You've also been a huge source of support for me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really appreciate you making this card for me. I promise to cherish it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I wanna go next!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Who should I do first...?
Hmm... Okay, MEIKO, I choose you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! “Thank you for always helping me whenever I'm in trouble!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: “Not only do you run our practices really well, you even go all out when we're having fun together! I really love how reliable and full of energy you are☆”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Are these hearts a representation of just how much you love me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Bingo!
And this smiley face is you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rin.
Please feel free to ask me for help whenever.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, next...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I think I'm up.
Ready, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's no need to feel so anxious.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway... I wanted to make you something that you'd really like, but as expected, they didn't exactly have an apple pie-shaped card or pie stickers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, I decided to use masking tape to get something close. Take a look.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow...! You really made this, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “You always keep a close eye on those around you and have their best interests at heart.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “There's probably a lot of good that you've done that I don't even know about.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “I firmly believe that we were only able to get this far because of you, Honami. Please keep being the great leader that you are.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I really appreciate you saying all this, Shiho.
And this card you made for me is so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you. I promise to treasure it forever.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This feels like a great way to enjoy your youth.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I feel like writing some thank-you messages too now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, we can pass out the rest later.
For now, let's start making our cards!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let us know if you have any questions♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We also brought decorative pens and such, so feel free to use them as you like.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... So many choices... I don't know which to pick...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Choosing a recipient will make that a lot easier. For example, for Miku's card...
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Captain Emu! At last, it's only us in this classroom!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Excellent! Then...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: It's time for our after-party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Keep it down.
There might still be people staying after school in the other classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I brought a ton of snacks!
Have as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And I brought the juice!
So, get your glasses ready!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Cheers!
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu, that reminds me.
Did you get a chance to give Tsukasa and the others their cards?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I told them lots and lots about how much I appreciate them! How about you two, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We also passed out our cards!
And afterwards, we made some more together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But it took a while to write our messages, since we were making cards for literally everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds really fun☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It was!
But I actually still have two cards left to give...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I also still have two!
What about you, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Same...
I mean, do we really need to make a big show of this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Then, I'll start with... My card for you, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “You have a talent for cheering people up and making everyone around you smile, Emu.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “That's why I always have fun whenever I'm with you. During our shadowing and while we helped out with the event, I was smiling the whole time because of you.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “And I really admire how hard you're working to make your dream a reality.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: “I wouldn't have learned as much as I did about how these sorts of events are run if it weren't for you, Emu!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“So, thank you for this wonderful experience!
I hope we get to do more stuff like this in the future!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
Oh no... I don't know what to say...
I feel so happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thanks for this, Saki!
Next, Shiho, it's my turn to give you your card!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “I really admire how cool and collected you always are, Shiho.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “But the way you smile whenever you look at something cute is also really adorable! The expression you make is so nice.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Even during our shadowing, you stayed focused and made sure our discussion went smoothly.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “I love how you're both really serious and really nice, Shiho! Thank you for always being such an amazing person☆”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I guess this means... I'm giving you my card next, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “We've known each other forever and been through a lot...”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “And you've become the person who best knows how to get me to go places and do stuff.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “I don't like wasting time, which usually means I push off taking breaks or hanging out with everyone...”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “But you know how to get me to do it. There were times when I just went along to make you stop begging me...”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Still, I usually end up enjoying whatever we do wherever we go. Our shadowing and that event we helped out with included.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You get worked up really easily, so I try not to say this too often...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But thank you for always taking me around places, Saki. You too, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for saying that, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Time for a thank you group hug!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, don't throw yourselves at me like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This is exactly what I was afraid of...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ It's your fault for saying what you did.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All's well that ends well☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure that's the phrase I'd use...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I hope we get to keep doing stuff together.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm so glad we got to visit the same company together. I feel like we're a lot closer to each other now.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And I'm really glad that I got this chance to show them just how much I appreciate them.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Because now I understand that us all being together is sort of a miracle...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So, I'm gonna make sure to thank them as much as I can moving forward!)

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
